actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.gravityforms_create_entry.descri: Saves an entry directly, without validation, feeds or notifications.
Other Entry Object properties, e.g. {"is_starred":1,"is_read":1,"status":"active","created_by":1,"source_url":"https://example.com/contact"}. Defaults to none.
Object of field ids to values, e.g. {"1":"Jane","2.3":"Doe","5":"jane@example.com"}. Sub-inputs like name parts use <field id>.<sub id>; get ids from Get Form.
Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.gravityforms_create_feed.descrip: Creates an add-on feed on a form.
actions.gravityforms_create_feed.props.a: The add-on that owns the feed, e.g. "gravityformsmailchimp" or "gravityformswebhooks".
actions.gravityforms_create_feed.props.f: Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.gravityforms_create_feed.props.m: The add-on's feed settings, e.g. {"feedName":"Send to CRM","requestURL":"https://example.com/hook"} for Webhooks.
actions.gravityforms_create_form.descrip: Creates a form with the given title and fields.
actions.gravityforms_create_form.props.a: Other Form Object properties to set, e.g. {"labelPlacement":"top_label","button":{"type":"text","text":"Send"}}. Defaults to none.
actions.gravityforms_create_form.props.d: Form description shown under the title.
actions.gravityforms_create_form.props.f: Array of Field Objects, e.g. [{"id":1,"type":"text","label":"Name","isRequired":true}]. Each field needs a unique numeric id.
actions.gravityforms_create_form.props.t: Form title, unique on the site.
actions.gravityforms_delete_entry.descri: Moves an entry to the trash, or deletes it permanently.
Numeric entry id, e.g. "159". Use List Entries to find it.
"true" deletes permanently and cannot be undone. Defaults to "false", which moves it to the trash.
actions.gravityforms_delete_feed.props.f: Numeric add-on feed id, e.g. "3". Use List Feeds to find it.
actions.gravityforms_delete_form.descrip: Moves a form to the trash, or deletes it permanently.
actions.gravityforms_delete_form.props.f: "true" deletes permanently and cannot be undone. Defaults to "false", which moves it to the trash.
Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.gravityforms_get_entry.descripti: Gets one entry with its field values.
actions.gravityforms_get_entry.props.ent: Numeric entry id, e.g. "159". Use List Entries to find it.
actions.gravityforms_get_feed.descriptio: Gets one add-on feed with its settings.
actions.gravityforms_get_feed.props.feed: Numeric add-on feed id, e.g. "3". Use List Feeds to find it.
actions.gravityforms_get_form.descriptio: Gets a form with its fields, notifications and confirmations.
actions.gravityforms_get_form.props.form: Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.gravityforms_get_form_results.de: Gets aggregated Quiz, Poll or Survey results for a form.
actions.gravityforms_get_form_results.pr: Array of filters, e.g. [{"key":"1","value":"Jane","operator":"contains"}]. key is a field id, entry property (e.g. "date_created", "is_starred") or meta key; operator is one of =, is, isnot, <>, contains, like, in, notin and defaults to "=". Use List Field Filters to see valid keys. Defaults to no filter.
"all" matches entries that pass every filter, "any" entries that pass at least one. Defaults to "all".
Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.
Which entries to include: "active", "spam" or "trash". Defaults to "active".
actions.gravityforms_list_entries.descri: Searches form entries with filters, sorting and paging.
Array of filters, e.g. [{"key":"1","value":"Jane","operator":"contains"}]. key is a field id, entry property (e.g. "date_created", "is_starred") or meta key; operator is one of =, is, isnot, <>, contains, like, in, notin and defaults to "=". Use List Field Filters to see valid keys. Defaults to no filter.
"all" matches entries that pass every filter, "any" entries that pass at least one. Defaults to "all".
Only return entries of this form, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it. Defaults to all forms.
Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
Field id or entry property to sort by, e.g. "date_created" or "3". Defaults to "id".
Which entries to include: "active", "spam" or "trash". Defaults to "active".
actions.gravityforms_list_feeds.descript: Lists add-on feeds, optionally for one form or one add-on.
actions.gravityforms_list_feeds.props.ad: Only return feeds of this add-on, e.g. "gravityformsmailchimp" or "gravityformswebhooks". Defaults to all add-ons.
actions.gravityforms_list_feeds.props.fo: Only return feeds of this form, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it. Defaults to all forms.
Lists the keys, operators and values a form's entries can be filtered by.
Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.gravityforms_list_forms.descript: Lists every form on the site with its id, title and entry count.
Sends an entry's form notifications (emails) again.
Numeric entry id, e.g. "159". Use List Entries to find it.
Notification event to send for, e.g. "form_submission". Defaults to "form_submission".
Only send these notifications, e.g. ["64f23a145de7b"]. Defaults to all notifications for the event.
actions.gravityforms_submit_form.descrip: Submits a form the way a site visitor would.
actions.gravityforms_submit_form.props.f: Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.gravityforms_submit_form.props.i: Object of input names to values, e.g. {"input_1":"Jane","input_2_3":"Doe","input_5":"jane@example.com"}. Names are input_<field id>, with _<sub id> for sub-inputs like name parts; get field ids from Get Form.
actions.gravityforms_submit_form.props.p: Object of dynamic population parameter names to values, used to evaluate conditional logic, e.g. {"source":"agent"}. Defaults to none.
actions.gravityforms_submit_form.props.s: Multi-page forms only: the page the values were submitted from. Defaults to 1.
actions.gravityforms_submit_form.props.t: Multi-page forms only: the page to go to next if this page is valid; 0 submits the form. Defaults to 0.
actions.gravityforms_update_entry.descri: Changes some of an entry's field values or properties.
Numeric entry id, e.g. "159". Use List Entries to find it.
Other Entry Object properties, e.g. {"is_starred":1,"is_read":1,"status":"active","created_by":1,"source_url":"https://example.com/contact"}. Defaults to none.
Object of field ids to new values, e.g. {"1":"Jane","2.3":"Doe"}. Fields not listed keep their value. Defaults to none.
actions.gravityforms_update_feed.descrip: Changes some of an add-on feed's settings, or turns it on or off.
actions.gravityforms_update_feed.props.f: Numeric add-on feed id, e.g. "3". Use List Feeds to find it.
Position of the feed among the form's feeds of the same add-on, starting at 0. Defaults to unchanged.
actions.gravityforms_update_feed.props.i: "true" turns the feed on, "false" turns it off. Defaults to unchanged.
actions.gravityforms_update_feed.props.m: Feed settings to change, e.g. {"feedName":"Send to CRM v2"}. Keys not sent keep their value. Defaults to none.
actions.gravityforms_update_form.descrip: Changes a form's title, description, fields or other properties.
actions.gravityforms_update_form.props.a: Other Form Object properties to change, e.g. {"labelPlacement":"left_label"}. Defaults to none.
actions.gravityforms_update_form.props.d: New form description. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.gravityforms_update_form.props.f: Full array of Field Objects that replaces the current fields. Get it from Get Form, edit it, and send it back. Leave empty to keep the fields.
Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.
actions.gravityforms_update_form.props.t: New form title. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.gravityforms_validate_submission: Checks form values against the form's validation rules without saving anything.
Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.

Object of input names to values, e.g. {"input_1":"Jane","input_2_3":"Doe","input_5":"jane@example.com"}. Names are input_<field id>, with _<sub id> for sub-inputs like name parts; get field ids from Get Form.
Object of dynamic population parameter names to values, used to evaluate conditional logic, e.g. {"source":"agent"}. Defaults to none.
Multi-page forms only: the page the values were submitted from. Defaults to 1.
Multi-page forms only: the page to go to next if this page is valid; 0 submits the form. Defaults to 0.
auth.description:
1. In WordPress, go to **Forms > Settings > REST API** and tick **Enabled** under "Enable access to the API".
2. Under **Authentication (API version 2)**, click **Add Key**, pick an administrator user and set **Permissions** to **Read/Write**.
3. Copy the **Consumer Key** and **Consumer Secret**; they are shown only once.
4. **Site URL** is your WordPress home address. It must start with https.
auth.props.siteUrl.description: Your WordPress site address, e.g. https://example.com
description: Build and publish your WordPress forms
triggers.new-submission.description: Triggers when form receives a new submission
triggers.new-submission.props.md.descrip:
- Go to the "Plugins" section.
- Find and click on the "Webhook" plugin to activate it.
- Now, locate the form where you want the trigger to occur.
- Add a webhook to that form.
- In the webhook settings, paste this URL: 
  ```text
  {{webhookUrl}}
  ```

- Keep the other settings unchanged (default).
